SELECT kc.*, kv.original_filename, kv.version_no, kd.status AS documentStatus FROM knowledge_chunk kc INNER JOIN knowledge_document_version kv ON kc.version_id = kv.id AND kv.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN knowledge_document kd ON kc.document_id = kd.id AND kd.del_flag = 0 AND kd.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE kc.del_flag = 0
AND ( kv.original_filename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR kv.version_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY kc.created_at DESC
